class.name: XboxUser
class.description: Wrapper around an Xbox user handle. Provides identity info like gamertag, XUID, age group, and sign-in state.

method.name: get_local_id
method.description: Returns the local user ID assigned by the GDK runtime.

method.name: get_xuid
method.description: Returns the Xbox User ID (XUID) as a string.

method.name: get_gamertag
method.description: Returns the user's classic gamertag (the [code]XUserGamertagComponent.Classic[/code] component).

method.name: get_modern_gamertag
method.description: Returns the user's modern gamertag without its numeric suffix. Empty on accounts or platforms that do not expose a modern gamertag.

method.name: get_modern_gamertag_suffix
method.description: Returns the numeric suffix of the user's modern gamertag, or an empty [String] when the gamertag has no suffix.

method.name: get_unique_modern_gamertag
method.description: Returns the user's modern gamertag combined with its suffix. This is the display string to use when a gamertag must be globally unique.

method.name: get_age_group
method.description: Returns the user's age group as an [enum AgeGroup] value.

method.name: get_age_group_name
method.description: Returns the user's age group as a human-readable string.

method.name: get_sign_in_state
method.description: Returns the user's sign-in state as a [enum SignInState] value.

method.name: get_sign_in_state_name
method.description: Returns the user's sign-in state as a human-readable string.

method.name: is_guest
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user is a guest account.

method.name: is_signed_in
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user is currently signed in.

method.name: is_store_user
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the user is the store user.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this wrapper still owns a native user handle. A default-constructed [XboxUser], or one whose handle has been released, returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_same_user
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param other] refers to the same platform user as this wrapper, even when the two wrappers are distinct objects (for example a cached user and a fresh [method XboxUsers.find_user_by_xuid] lookup). Returns [code]false[/code] when [param other] is [code]null[/code] or when either wrapper has no live handle (see [method is_valid]).

method.name: duplicate_user
method.description: Returns a new [XboxUser] backed by a duplicated native handle, or [code]null[/code] if this wrapper holds no handle. Use this when the title needs to keep a user alive independently of the [XboxUsers] cache; the duplicate closes its own handle when it is freed.
